note: Advanced Insert View is a text-format filter (plugin id insert_view_adv) that embeds views from rich text via [view:name=display=args] tokens or <drupal-view> tags, rendered through render placeholders; it also ships a CKEditor 5 button. It has no admin config route (configure=null) — enabling and settings live per text format in filter.format.<format> under filters.insert_view_adv (status + settings allowed_views/render_as_empty/hide_argument_input). Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: introspection finds which format has the filter enabled; execution enables the filter on a format, verified by filters.insert_view_adv.status === TRUE. Rendering an actual embedded view needs a real view + request context, so cases target the filter configuration, not rendered output.

evals.prompt: Using the Advanced Insert View (insert_view_adv) module, what token syntax do I type in a body field to embed a view called 'articles' using its 'page_1' display and pass the argument 5?
evals.expected_output: [view:articles=page_1=5] — the syntax is [view:name=display=args]; omit the display to use the default, and separate multiple arguments with slashes. A <drupal-view> tag is the equivalent produced by the CKEditor plugin.

evals.prompt: The Advanced Insert View filter has no admin settings page. Where is it enabled and configured, and what are its three filter settings?
evals.expected_output: It is enabled per text format (Configuration > Text formats and editors; config filter.format.<format>.filters.insert_view_adv). Its settings are allowed_views (whitelist of view=display; empty allows all), render_as_empty, and hide_argument_input.

evals.prompt: Why should the Advanced Insert View filter only be granted to trusted text formats, and what must be true of every view that can be embedded?
evals.expected_output: The filter can render any view, so it should be limited to trusted formats/roles. Every embeddable view and display (including the default display) must have correct Views access permissions, because build() only renders a view after $view->access($display_id) passes.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which text format has the Advanced Insert View (insert_view_adv) filter enabled? Inspect the live filter format configuration and give the format's machine name.
evals.expected_output: iva_eval — its filter.format.iva_eval config has filters.insert_view_adv.status = true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format with machine name 'iva_eval_hard'. Enable the Advanced Insert View (insert_view_adv) filter on that format and save it, so editors using that format can embed views.
evals.expected_output: In filter.format.iva_eval_hard set filters.insert_view_adv.status = true (with id/provider insert_view_adv and its settings) and save. Verified: filters.insert_view_adv.status === TRUE on the live format.

evals.prompt: We have a text format called 'iva_eval_hard'. I want editors to be able to drop a view into the body using that format. Turn on the feature that lets them embed views, and save the format.
evals.expected_output: Enable the Advanced Insert View filter (insert_view_adv) on the iva_eval_hard text format and save. Verified: filters.insert_view_adv.status === TRUE.
